_comment: Fixed task splits of `aidev-evolve eval`: Terminal-Bench 2.1 at task_commit, GLM-5.3-Flash at low effort. validation: the 8 tasks every version is scored on (their trajectories are read while fixing). heldout: 20 tasks nobody reads, for the check at the end. Chosen on 19 Nov 2026 from paired sweeps on a 34-task pool, 4 trials each, so that each of the three planted flaws costs passes on the validation tasks; the other 6 pool tasks are not used. On 26 Nov 2026 build-pmars moved from heldout to validation in place of sqlite-with-gcov, which left the package (12.6 MB of task files, and its sandbox start or verifier made 2 of 4 first evaluations take 273 to 329 s). eval_budget_s: agent time per task (chosen on 25 Nov 2026 from ladders at 90, 120 and 180 s).
